title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's BA-201 exam
question:
Cloud Kicks has completed the user acceptance testing (UAT) phase of a major update to Sales Cloud for its EMEA sales team.
How should the business analyst help the EMEA sales team learn the new features?
option_A: Organize user groups by permission set and train each team.
option_B: Document key changes and gather feedback to update the backlog.
option_C: Build tooltips and discoverable content in the new console layouts.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's BA-201 exam
question:
The business analyst (BA) at Cloud Kicks (CK) is writing user stones for an upcoming Commerce Cloud website release. One of the requirements from the technical team is to perform stress testing for an upcoming promotion. The BA is translating the requirement into a user story.
Which user story most accurately represents the goal?
option_A: As a visitor to the CK website, I want to make sure that I can shop without disruption during a large promotion so I have a frictionless shopping experience.
option_B: As a site administrator of the CK website, I want to make sure that the web server can process requests at 150% of the average traffic rate during the latest promotion.
option_C: As a user, I want to make sure that shoppers on the CK website can complete their purchases without disruption during the newest promotion.

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's BA-201 exam
question:
During a requirements gathering session, two stakeholders discuss the names of the fields they want to see when adding leads to the system. Each stakeholder has a different point of view on field names.
What should the business analyst do to help Influence the team and accurately capture the requirements?
option_A: Find a middle ground where both stakeholders are satisfied with the field names.
option_B: Ask the executive sponsor to make the final field name decisions.
option_C: Allow the development team to make the final field name decisions.
